title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Chengdu
description: Explore Chengdu's top natural wine bars for unique, additive-free pours. Discover the best spots for biodynamic wines, delightful small plates, and vibrant atmospheres.

places.name: VINVINO (酒花花)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any biodynamic Chenin Blanc, paired with their truffle pasta or artisanal cheese platter.

places.name: Bar Pipi (庇庇酒馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A funky orange wine with their spicy chicken karage and lotus root fries.

places.name: The Box Bar (盒子酒吧)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A low-intervention Pinot Noir alongside their Sichuanese-inspired duck confit bao.

places.name: Flow (酒流)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp Pecorino (natural) with their bruschetta selection and prosciutto.

places.name: Wild Yeast Cellar (野生酵母酒窖)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pét-nat (pétillant naturel) to start, followed by a bold natural red, paired with their charcuterie board.

places.name: The Daily Wine Club (日常酒社)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their 'wine of the day' for the best value, often paired with simple, tasty snacks like olives or toasted bread.

places.name: Maison Sans Pression (无压之家)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural Burgundy Chardonnay with their steak frites or artisanal cheese board.

places.name: Vinosofia Wine Bar (维诺索菲亚酒吧)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any Lambrusco (natural), or ask for a specific region like Friuli for unique white natural wines. Pair with focaccia and cured meats.

places.name: La Cave du Cochonette (小猪酒窖)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural Loire Valley Cabernet Franc with their rich beef bourguignon or confit de canard.

places.name: Grape Republic Wine Bar (葡萄共和国酒馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for a skin-contact wine (orange wine) and one of their seasonal vegetarian small plates.

places.name: The Vine Library (葡萄藤书屋)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A delicate, aromatic natural white wine while curled up with a good book from their shelves.

places.name: Rooftop Garden Bar (顶楼花园酒吧)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing natural rosé or an elegant sparkling natural wine to enjoy with the city lights.
